prompts.prompt: Generate a production-ready transparent-background fantasy MOBA spell-effect sprite atlas. EXACT GRID: 4 columns and 8 rows, 32 equally-sized rectangular cells, no gutter beyond clear padding inside each cell, no captions, no borders, no UI, no background. Canvas portrait 1:2 aspect ratio. Every row is a single spell animation with FOUR sequential left-to-right frames: anticipation, active strong effect, continuation, fading ending. Stylized realistic hand-painted game VFX matching cold dark blue icy ARAM bridge art, sharp silhouettes, restrained luminous color, not childish. Keep every effect fully contained in its own cell, at least 8% clear padding all sides, exact centered position and consistent scale across the row. No sprite may overlap neighboring cells. Motion sprites face RIGHT. Ground spells viewed top-down, lightly isometric perspective, with readable rim silhouettes and transparent centers. Each of the eight rows from top to bottom MUST be: 1: spectral teal metal hook head flying toward RIGHT, no long chain; 2: floating ornate green soul lantern, glow pulses, centered; 3: wide horizontal green chain sweep, directional wave flows from LEFT to RIGHT; rectangular flay strip; 4: five-sided pentagonal prison of five spectral teal pillars joined by bright low walls, top-down view, hollow empty center; 5: small sharp purple dark-magic bolt flying RIGHT; 6: meteor warning magical purple circle then purple falling meteor then circular explosion then fading purple crater; all share centered footprint; 7: circular violet cage with evenly spaced tall magical pillars around rim, hollow transparent center, grows from runes to bright activated cage; 8: large dense violet-black execute orb flying RIGHT, dangerous white lavender core. Do not draw heroes or scenery. Transparent alpha around and inside effects. Make each row visually distinct and coherent across all four frames.
